name: ElevenLabs CLI
desc: Terminal client that exposes the whole ElevenLabs voice API
desc_zh: 把整套 ElevenLabs 语音 API 搬进终端的命令行工具
solves: Scripting voice work meant writing SDK boilerplate and pasting API keys into throwaway files. The CLI turns every endpoint into one command and previews each call before it runs.
solves_zh: 写语音脚本要先搭 SDK 样板，还得把密钥粘进临时文件。这个命令行把每个接口变成一条命令，执行前先预览效果。
best_for: When you want a batch of narration files rendered overnight without opening a browser or a code editor.
best_for_zh: 想在一夜之间批量产出配音文件，又不想打开浏览器或编辑器的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ElevenLabs blog index (elevenlabs.io/blog), post "Introducing the ElevenLabs）。 Announced as v1 on the ElevenLabs blog. The installer and releases live in the vendor's own GitHub repository (github.com/elevenlabs/cli), which is the product entry for a CLI, so that repo is used as homepage. No independent press coverage found; second source is the vendor's own documentation root. 首次公开日期来源：https://elevenlabs.io/blog/elevenlabs-cli-v1
